I checked the unconnected groups. The cave, the outcrop (b151 and its parts) and the treasure nook (b221 and its parts) are already one group. The outcrop is joined to the plate b15 and the bricks b218 and b219. The nook is joined to b116, b126 and b127. The torches are on b227 and b219, so they are in the same group.

The three remaining groups are real separate items in the booklet, so I did not join them to the cave. (1) The spider (b129 to b150) is built separately from bag 2 as a stand-alone creature, like the minifigures, and is only placed beside the cave. (2) The bucket (b233 to b235) is a loose accessory that the final picture shows standing on the table. (3) The Orange round plate b236 is also shown loose.
I added one contact edge so the orange round plate b236 belongs to the bucket accessory. The picture shows it resting beside the bucket. It is the only change.
No pieces are fastened to the cave for the spider or the bucket. Inventing joins would make the graph wrong.

The Steve, Zombie and spider-head minifigure parts, and the pickaxe (lego-18789), are in the parts list but are not recorded. The booklet only shows them as minifigure assembly, with no join to the cave.

The three groups are not a mistake in the graph, because the booklet builds three separate models: (1) the cave, including the outcrop, the treasure nook and the torches, which are joined to it in steps 9, 10, 6 and 7; (2) the spider (b129 to b150), built from bag 2 and shown beside the cave in the final picture, not joined to it; (3) the bucket accessory (b233 to b236), also a loose item shown on the table next to the cave.

No page shows the spider or the bucket being fastened to the cave, and the final picture shows them standing apart. Joining them would add a connection the manual does not make, so I left them separate.
No new pieces or edges are added in this reply. Everything already given stays as it is.
